This is one frozen OMX workbench top camera image, exactly 640 by 480 pixels. No robot commands are requested. Return JSON only, with keys coordinate_system,targets,equipment,limitations,can_localize_for_grasp. targets is a list of {id,label,bbox_xyxy,visibility,uncertainties}. label must be one of brown_cylinder_like,white_round_region,red_strawberry_like,other_small_object. bbox_xyxy is four integer NORMALIZED coordinates x1,y1,x2,y2 in the range 0..1000, bounded by 0<=x1<x2<=1000 and 0<=y1<y2<=1000, relative to the original image. Set coordinate_system to normalized_1000. List each visible loose target instance separately, including partially visible ones at image borders. visibility is fully_visible,border_clipped,or occluded. Exclude robot components and fixtures from targets; list them in equipment instead. Use appearance labels only: a white circle does not establish a sphere, and red fruit shape does not establish real fruit or material. Do not invent hidden objects or metric/depth/joint coordinates. If a view has no identifiable loose targets return targets=[]. uncertainties and limitations must explain unobservable attributes and visibility. can_localize_for_grasp must be false because calibration and depth are unverified. Korean text for descriptions.
